Administration

Auto WhatsApp- Create communication rules to send WhatsApp messages automatically
at the time of entry.

A new function has been introduced in the Communication Rule of the Communicator menu
in the Administration module. Now, WhatsApp messages for any document(s) are sent
automatically at the time of entry or after final-level approval, following the rules set in the
communication rule.

Now the WhatsApp message is automatically sent to the registered mobile number during
Entry or after Approval of any provisional document(s).

Navigation: Administration Module Communicator Communication Rule

To check the auto WhatsApp, Open Communication Rule of Communicator menu from
Administration Module. Set the communication rule, then create any document, and check
the Register-WhatsApp menu.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 3
Farvision Release 3.2: January 2024 (SP 148-SP 153)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WhatsApp Message Delivery status update (Administration >> Communicator >>

Register-WhatsApp)
A new function has been introduced in the Register-WhatsApp.
i.e., Users can see the actual WhatsApp message status in the grid.
If a WhatsApp message is in the Outbox, the status is shown as "Queued for
provider". Once it moves to the Sent Item, the status is shown as "Sent to provider"
or "Delivered to user" or "Read by user".
o When the message is sent without the internet connection, the status will
be "Sent to provider". When message is delivered, status will be "Delivered
to user". Once the message is read, the status will be "Read by user".

Application Security
A feature has been developed to enhance the Security in the system through multiple VAPT
assessments (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing). This process helps to
identify and fix security weakness well in advance before the attackers can exploit them.

Performance Improvements for Reports, Import and Queue
Changes have been introduced to improve the memory consumption in the Reports, Import
and Queue process. This will also help improve the server performance.

User Edit/Delete Rights - Edit/Delete rights for provisional documents will only be
available for the approvers/administrators at the respective level

A new function has been introduced in Edit and Delete rights i.e. Edit/Delete rights for
provisional documents will only be available for the approvers/administrators at their
respective levels. Maker/Approval at below levels should not be allowed to modify (Edit and
Delete) the document if it is currently with the approver. This restriction aims to prevent
unauthorized alterations or discrepancies in the document, thereby enhancing overall
efficiency.

Additional Fields (Mollak Code, Mollak Description, Oracle BU Code, Input Credit Not
Applicable (Non-Taxable) and Effective Date) have been added in Business Unit Extra Info
page for UAE'S Company.

A new function has been introduced on the Extra Info page of Business Unit, namely: Mollak
Code, Mollak Description, Oracle BU Code, Input Credit Not Applicable (Non-Taxable) and
Effective Date for UAE'S company. These additional fields will only function at the Business
Unit level and not at the Enterprise or Group of Company or Company level.

During the creation or editing of a Business Unit, please ensure that the Mollak Code, Mollak
Description, and Oracle BU Code are unique, with Mollak Code and Oracle BU Code not
exceeding nine (9) and four (4) characters, respectively. If the user or maker fills the Mollak
Code, Mollak Description, and Oracle BU Code and submits, it is successfully submitted.
Similarly, if the user or maker fills the Mollak Code, Mollak Description, Oracle BU Code, and
Effective Date and clicks on submit, it is also submitted successfully. If the user or maker fills
the Mollak Code, Mollak Description, Oracle BU Code, and Effective Date, clicks on the
checkbox for Input Credit Not Applicable (Non-Taxable), and submits, it is also successfully
submitted.

However, if the user or maker attempts to create a Business Unit by selecting the checkbox
for Input Credit Not Applicable (Non-Taxable) without specifying an Effective Date, it is not
possible, and a warning message will be displayed. Similarly, attempting to uncheck the
Input Credit Not Applicable (Non-Taxable) without specifying an Effective Date is not
possible.

except India from the Address Page Extra Info

Improvisation of Segment and Zone in Sub Ledger Trial Balance

There are improvised `Segment' and `Zone' options in Sub Ledger Trial Balance Report so
that the report can be generated by Segment / Zone wise also.

STEPS OF SUB LEDGER TRIAL BALANCE REPORT GENERATION

Upon logging into Farvision, the Sub Ledger Trial Balance Report generation process
begins.

In the Administration Module, navigate to Setup > Enterprise Hierarchy > Business
Unit Segment to create segments. Input necessary data (Code, Description, Parent)
and submit.

For zone creation, access the Administration Module > Setup > Enterprise Hierarchy
> Zone. Enter required data (Code, Description) and submit.

Tag Business Units with their respective Segment / Zone in the Administration
Module.

Observe the effects in the Segment/Zone Wise Sub Ledger Trial Balance Report
resulting from the execution of Receipt-Payment Entries and Journal Entries in the
tagged Business Units within the Financial Module, adhering to specified
requirements.

To generate the Sub Ledger Trial Balance Report, navigate to the Financial Module,
access the Trial Balance, proceed to Sub Ledger Trial Balance, input necessary data
(Group of Companies/Company/Business Unit/Segment/Zone, Custom Date, Control
Account, Option, Show Net Balance, Provisional), and click on PDF/Excel.

3. Sales Order header requires GSTIN :

When a user forgets to change GSTIN (multiple registrations) of a customer in item wise
billing period, but the order is saved and running perfectly, the entire effort is lost.
To address the changes, a function has been added to sales orders, and users can now enter
the customer's GSTIN in the sales order's primary information. After selecting GSTIN in the
Sales Order Main Info, the user should not need to open the GST pop-up in the item-by-
item billing period to select GSTIN from the customer's multiple registrations. The system
will automatically determine the tax amount based on the GST number entered.

New Feature Addition

1. Major Security Improvements:
The feature has been developed to enhance system security through multiple VAPT assessments
(Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing). This process helps to identify and fix security
weaknesses well in advance before they can be exploited by attackers.

2. File storage methodology improved:
Now, the file download path has been improved to be category-wise. Previously, all the files
were downloaded in one path, but after changes, they will be downloaded according to their
respective categories.

3. Files upload using web links:
Any file can be uploaded using a web link into the attachment section of the page where the
attachment option exists.

Steps:-

1. Navigate to the Transaction section, such as Requisition from the Material Module.

4. Select Weblink

the web link, it will be saved on the server.

1. Open the desired transaction from the Transaction section, such as Booking from the CRM
Module.

be selected in the box labelled "Value". If the mail is to be sent App-wise BU-wise, the
configuration type must be set to App-wise BU-wise, and the Application name and BU name can
be selected in the box labelled "Value".

4. Discontinuing a user and Associated Workflow

This update includes an important enhancement to the user discontinuation process.

If the user is not a part of any business rule or work flow then user can be simply discontinued
without further interactions.

If The use is part of any business rule or work flow then System will ask for different options before
actual Discontinue.

When a user is discontinued with the option Discontinue anyway, then the user will be
automatically discontinued but there will be no impact on the business rule and provisional
document.

When a user is discontinued with the option Discontinue and replace, then the user will be
automatically discontinued and replace by the new user from all associated workflows
(business rule and provisional document).

When a user is discontinued with the option Discontinue and remove, then the user will be
automatically discontinued and removed the existing user from all associated business rule.
(elaboration of scenarios has been mentioned below)

Steps:-

Navigate to the Admin Module.
Go to the User section.

Calculation of Gratuity

Less than 1 Year of Service:
The system should not provide any gratuity if an employee has less than one year of service.

Service between 1 to 5 Years:
For employees with 1 to 5 years of service, the system should calculate gratuity as 21 days'
salary for each year of service.

Calculation:

o This employee work in this company from 1/4/2022 to 1/2/2024 and the basic pay for a
day of the employee is 1333.33.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 58
Farvision Release 3.5

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

o Total days of service will be 672 days.
o We will get the Total year of service by dividing "total days of service (672)/365 days",

so the Total Year of service will be 1.84.
o The End of Service Days (EOS Days) will be calculated based on the formula chosen in the

Pay Structure definition. Currently, we are using the basic formula for gratuity
calculation: "Total years of service (1.84)* 21", so the EOS Days will be 38.64 Days.
o To calculate the End of Service (EOS) Payable "End of Service Days (38.64) * Basic salary
(1333.33)", so the EOS payable will be 51520.22.

Service greater than 5 Years:

For employees with more than 5 years of service, the system should calculate gratuity as:
o 21 days' salary for each of the first five years of service.
o 30 days' salary for each additional year of service beyond the first five years.

o This employee work in this company from 10/3/2015 to 13/2/2024 and the basic pay of

o The End of Service Days (EOS Days) will be calculated based on the formula chosen in the
Pay Structure definition. Currently, we are using the basic formula for gratuity
calculation: "(21*5) + {(total year of Service- 5) * 30}", so the EOS Days will be 223.20
Days.
o To calculate the End of Service (EOS) Payable "End of Service Days (223.20) * Basic salary
(1333.33)", so the EOS payable will be 297600.00.

25. Introduced Eligible Amount Calculation Logic in Payment Requisition for
Work Order with Amendment

In this feature, if there are amendments to the work order gross amount, the system must
automatically adjust the eligible amount calculations according to the provided logic.
The user interface for entering payment requisitions should prominently display the calculated
eligible amount based on the implemented logic.

Step: Logic to work as per below scenario:

Example: Say Work Order gross amount (including tax) = 118. Page 108
� Gamut Infosystems Limited
Farvision Release 3.5

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Advance Requisition done = 22.
Therefore, eligible amount will be (118 - 22) = 96.

Case 1: RA Bill created with gross amount inclusive of tax = 28.
Advance was earlier created for 22. Hence, extra of (28-22) is to be reduced from
the eligible amount.
Hence, revised eligible amount = 96 -6 = 90.
Further RA Bill (2) was created will gross amount of 18.
Now, revised eligible amount = 90- 18 = 72.

Case 2: Work Order has been amended and gross amount (including tax) after amendment = 138.
Advance Requisition earlier done = 22.
Therefore, eligible amount will be (138 - 22) = 116.

Now, RA Bill created with gross amount inclusive of tax = 28.
Advance was earlier created for 22. Hence, extra of (28-22) is to be reduced from
the eligible amount.

Hence, revised eligible amount = 116 -6 = 110.
Further, RA Bill (2) was created will gross amount of 18.
Now, revised eligible amount = 110 - 18 = 92.

Case 3: Work Order has been amended and gross amount (including tax) after amendment = 98.
Advance Requisition earlier done = 22.
Therefore, eligible amount will be (98 - 22) = 76.

Now, RA Bill created with gross amount inclusive of tax = 28.
Advance was earlier created for 22. Hence, extra of (28-22) is to be reduced from
the eligible amount.
Hence, revised eligible amount = 76 -6 = 70.
Further, RA Bill (2) was created will gross amount of 18.
Now, revised eligible amount = 70 - 18 = 52.

Note: The above cases will go on and forth. However, the logic to remain the same.

Farvision ERP Release 4.1 Highlights

Transforming Efficiency Across Modules

Welcome to the latest ERP release, designed to empower your business operations with a suite of
innovative features and enhancements. Dive into a new era of efficiency, control, and user-centric
design. Here's what's new across key modules:

Administration

Streamlined Access: Implement Single Sign-On (SSO) to simplify and secure user
authentication by allowing users to log in with a single set of credentials across multiple
modules.

Enhanced Security: Ensure tighter data protection through automatic logout upon browser
closure. This helps to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive information.

Finance

IND-AS Compliance: Generate detailed notes and schedule as an integral part of Balance
Sheet.

Multicurrency Support: Simplify international transactions with multicurrency options in
payment requisition.

Focused Insights: Get real-time insights into all pending electronic payments, ensuring
timely follow-ups and efficient cash flow management through the "E-Payment Pending"
report.

Segment Reporting: The "Trial Balance Columnar Segment and Business Unit Wise" report
provides actionable financial data by offering detailed insights into financial performance
across different segments and business units.

Payment Control: A new feature 'Party wise Hold' allows users to hold payments party-wise,
offering precise financial control.

Payroll

Comprehensive Registers: Processed attendance data available on the Employee Portal with
detailed cost allocation.

Strengthening Employee Communication & Control: Automatic email triggers for key events
such as welcome mail, outdoor, work anniversaries and expenses.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 3
Farvision Release 4.1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Material Management

Vendor-Centric Updates: Suppliers can now view, export, and manage their approved
invoices, debit notes, and GRNs directly from the portal.

Dynamic Dashboard: Widgets highlight Pending Store Requisitions and Resubmissions,
keeping you ahead of tasks.

Streamlined Shipments: Allows suppliers to create and submit ASN (Advance Shipment
Note) for shipments directly through the portal, with a provisional GRN automatically
generated for the store department.

PMS

Revenue Management: Enabled management of Revenue Headwise Openings in the PMS
module.

Sales Force Automation

Bulk Updates: Streamline lead management with new bulk update features. modify lead
details such as Status, Owner, Campaign, Priority, Zone, and Origin in one action.

Quick Insights: Birthday and anniversary widgets are available to personalize customer
engagements.

Sales and Customer Care

Automated Processes: Generate QR codes for transaction print formats. This feature is
incorporated in the following transaction menus: Sales Deed, Agreement, Invoice and
Allotment to establish authenticity.

Validation Enhancements: Restrict receipt creation for amounts over 10% of unit cost
without an agreement.

This feature has been added in order to comply with the IND-AS requirement.
Ind-AS requires the company may disclose Investments by grouping them in the following manner.
Broad categories (viz. measured at Amortised Cost, measured at FVTPL, measured at FVTOCI,

measured at cost etc.)
Under each broad categories, nature-based (viz. Investment in Equity, Investment in Pref.,

Investment in debt etc.)
Under each nature-based, grouping based on the relationship of bodies corporate (viz.,

subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures etc.)

Example: - A company holds equity securities or derivatives, it would be classified as an FVTPL asset
or a company holds debt instruments and want to classify it in FVTOCI or through Amortised cost.

Further,
Schedule III provides for certain disclosures where the company is a partner in partnership firms.
In the Balance Sheet, under the sub-heading "Non-current Investments", separate disclosure is to be
made of any investment in the capital of partnership firm by the company.

8. Employee's cost allocation for multiple BU based on organization

assignment

Earlier, an employee can only be associated with one Business Unit (BU) for payment within a
month. The new feature will enable employee salaries to be calculated based on the work
completed for each respective business unit within a single month.

For Example:
For October month, the employee works 8 days in BU-A, 23 days in BU-B, the system should sum
the days worked in BU-A & BU-B and the sum should equal to the payslip amount.

Calculation:
Payslip Amount = Rs20000
Total number of days worked by the employee in BU-A = 8
Total number of days worked by the employee in BU-B = 23

For BU-A = (20000/31)*8 =5161.29
For BU-B = (20000/31)*23 =14838.70

Total = BU-A + BU-B = 20000(Round off)

assessment

The calculation for these increments will be based on three methods:

Prorata on Present Days
Fixed Leave Increment
Prorata on Present Plus Leave Days

1) Prorata on Present Day means that the casual leave entitlement is calculated proportionally
based on the number of days an employee has worked in a quarter.

Example: If an employee's quarterly leave increment is 3 days and they work the entire 3 months
without taking any leave, they will receive the full 3 days of casual leave. However, if the employee
takes one day leave/absent their leave increment will be reduced based on prorata.

2) Fixed Leave Increment means that regardless of whether the employee has taken any
leave/Absent or not, a fixed number of leave days will be added to their balance.

Example: Even if an employee takes 2 leave days in a quarter, they will still receive the full 3 days of
leave in the quarterly leave increment.

3) Leave Increment Pro-rata on Present Plus Leave Days means that the leave increment is
calculated based on the number of days an employee is present, plus any leave days they
have taken. This ensures that employees receive a fair amount of leave based on their actual
working days and the leave they have utilized.

3. Add Validation for IP and MAC Address in Security System

High Level Description:

The Security System involves implementing IP/MAC validation during user login. It
includes adding fields for IP/MAC validation, comparing the user's current IP/MAC
with stored data, and showing error messages for unauthorized access. The system
will also address missing addresses, location changes, and handle multiple failed
attempts to ensure secure access management.

Details:

If enable IP validation and enable MAC validation is on, IP address and MAC address

field will be enabled.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 15
Farvision Release 4.2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If IP and MAC validation both is enabled users will be restricted to login for that IP

and MAC address.

Check the user's current IP address against the stored IP Address. If "IP Address
Validation Required" is "Yes", and stored IP address does not match with current
login IP address and vice versa then system will show an error message and do not
allow to login.

Check the user's current MAC address against the stored MAC address. If "MAC
Address Validation Required" is "Yes", and stored MAC address does not match with
current MAC address and vice versa then system will show an error message and do
not allow to login.

If both "IP Address Validation Required" and "MAC Address Validation Required" are
set to "Yes", system will check both IP and MAC addresses.

If IP Address and MAC Address both are enabled, there can be an option to register
multiple IP Address and multiple MAC Address using semicolon operator. For this,
login can be done through any one of the IP Address and MAC Address. If only
"Enable IP Validation" is yes and "Enable MAC Validation" is no, system will check
multiple IP Address and If only "Enable MAC Validation" is yes and "Enable IP
Validation" is no, system will check multiple MAC Address mentioned in the field.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 16
Farvision Release 4.2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The user needs to go FV Web Service, and install .exe file. If .exe file is not installed
and executed on the system linked to their assigned IP address, they will not be able
to log in if IP and/or MAC address validation is enabled. As per the client's system
configuration, the .exe file must be correctly registered on the user's device to allow
full tracking and enable access to the service.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 17

If either IP or MAC addresses don't match, display error: "Access from Unauthorized
IP address and/or MAC Address."

If both "IP Address Validation Required" and "MAC Address Validation Required" are
set to "No", allow the login without restrictions.

29. Alert Configuration for Miss Punch & No Punch

Introduced configurable alert notifications in Farvision for Miss Punch and No Punch scenarios to

Path: Payroll >> Setup >> configuration >> Alert Configuration

Missed/No Punch Alert Configuration Explanation:

In this setup, you can configure when email alerts should be triggered for missed/No punch events.
The alert timing is controlled using two fields: Days and Time.

Type: should be Missed / No Punch Alert
Days: Specifies how many days back the system should check for missed/no punches.
Time: Specifies the exact time of day when the alert email should be sent.

Example � 1 Days Configuration:

If the Days field is set to 1 and the Time is set to 11:00 AM, the system will check for any missed or
no punches of yesterday (e.g., June 18, 2025) and send the alert email on today (June 19, 2025) at
11:00 AM.

Example � 3 Days Configuration:

If the Days field is set to 3 and the Time is set to 11:00 AM, the system will check for missed or no
punches from three days ago (e.g., June 16, 2025) and send the alert email on today (June 19, 2025)
at 11:00 AM

57. Manual Reminder Logic Updated

To improve the efficiency and consistency of payment follow-ups, the Manual Reminder logic has
been significantly enhanced.

Manual Reminder Logic:

The updated logic now handles three key scenarios:

Scenario 1: Due is Not Paid or Greater Than Minimum Value

o Oldest due is selected.
o Reminders sent at scheduled intervals.
o New invoices are added to the total in the next reminder.
o After the last scheduled reminder, the next one follows the interval difference (e.g.,

20 - 10 = 10 days).

Example:

10,000 due on Jan 1
Reminders: Jan 5, Jan 10
New invoice 5,000 on Jan 11
Next reminders: Jan 20 15,000, Jan 30 15,000

Scenario 2: Due is Fully Paid or Below Minimum Value

o If remaining due is below the minimum threshold or no due exists, the reminder
cycle resets.

o New outstanding triggers a fresh reminder cycle from the first interval.

Example:

10,000 due on Jan 1, minimum value 500
9,700 paid on Jan 10 Remaining 300
New invoice 5,000 on Jan 11
Next reminder: Jan 15 5,300 (restart from first interval)

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 574

In the To Technician field, select the technician who should receive the task.

Select tasks from the table shown below (or choose to transfer all tasks).
Click Transfer to reassign the selected tasks to the new technician.

Validation: The system will not proceed with the transfer if any required field is left
blank.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 689
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2.11. Query

The Overview Page under the Query of the CAFM module offers a consolidated
dashboard to monitor the real-time status of all maintenance activities. This includes
service requests (SR), planned preventive maintenance (PPM), and reactive orders.
The dashboard is categorized into seven key segments: Pending PPM, Pending SR,
Pending Reactive, Overdue PPM, Overdue Reactive, Closed PPM, and Closed
Reactive.

Steps:

Navigation to : Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Query > Overview

Segment-Wise Functional Details:

Pending PPM:
o Displays the count and list of PPM Work Orders that are yet to be
performed or closed.

Pending SR:
o Displays the count and list of Pending Service Requests raised via the
Community Portal.

Pending Reactive:
o Displays the count and list of Reactive Work Orders that are still open
or not completed.

Overdue PPM:

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 690
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

o Lists and counts of overdue PPM Work Orders not started or
completed within the SLA resolution time.

Overdue Reactive:
o Lists and counts of overdue Reactive Orders not executed within their
respective SLA resolution time.

Closed PPM:
o Displays a list of closed and completed PPM Work Orders for review
or reference.

Closed Reactive:
o Displays a list of closed and completed Reactive Orders for audit or
historical analysis.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 691
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

3. CAFM Module � Reports Help Guide

This section provides an overview of the reporting features available in the CAFM Module.
These reports enable users to monitor asset performance, maintenance history, pending
actions, and quotation statuses. All reports include Excel download options for offline
analysis and record-keeping.

3.1. Equipment Performance Report (Asset)

This report displays the count of Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) and
Reactive Maintenance activities created against each asset, helping assess asset
reliability and maintenance load.

Steps:

Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Reports > Equipment Performance Report

Name or code of the equipment.
Number of PPM tasks created for the asset.
Number of reactive maintenance tasks performed.
Report can be exported in Excel format.

3.2. Report Pending Quotation

This report shows details of pending quotations raised against Reactive Orders but
not yet processed or finalized.

Steps:

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 692
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Quotation > Report Pending Quotation
The order associated with the pending quotation.
Status and amount of the quotation.
Report is available in Excel format.

3.3. PPM Report
This report displays all created PPM Work Orders.

Steps:
Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Reports > PPM Report

Summary of all PPM Work Orders.
Excel export available.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 693
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

3.4. Pending PPM Scheduling Report
This Report Shows PPM schedules where work orders have not yet been generated.

Steps:
Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Reports >Pending PPM Scheduling Report
Displays pending schedules awaiting PPM work order creation.
Excel export available.

3.5. Reactive Report

Generates the Reactive Order Register Report, which lists details of all reactive
maintenance orders.

Steps:

Farvision UI Framework > CAFM Module > Reports > Reactive Report

Complete list of Reactive Orders with detailed information.
Available in Excel format.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 694
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 695
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

4. CAFM Module � Dashboard Widgets

The CAFM dashboard provides key performance widgets that offer real-time insights into
maintenance tasks and service requests. These widgets help users quickly assess due,
overdue, and upcoming tasks, improving decision-making and response time.

Each widget is interactive--clicking on them will navigate users to a detailed list view of the
corresponding records.

Available Widgets and Their Functions:

4.1. Reactive Due Today : Displays the count of reactive orders that are due for action
today.

4.2. PPMs Due Today : Shows the number of Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM)
work orders scheduled for today.

4.3. Reactive Missed SLA : Shows the count of reactive orders that are overdue and have
breached their SLA resolution time.

4.4. PPMs Missed SLA : Displays the number of PPM work orders that have passed their
SLA time without completion.

4.5. Reactive Other Than Today : Lists the count of pending reactive orders, excluding
those due today.

4.6. Pending SR : Shows the count of pending service requests raised by residents or
users.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 696
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5. CAFM Mobile APP

5.1. Overview

The CAFM (Computer-Aided Facility Management) mobile application is available on
both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store. This application is designed to
streamline the maintenance process for assets, focusing on both Preventive
Maintenance (PPM) Work Orders and Reactive Orders.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 697
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 698
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5.2. Today's Work Orders
This section displays four different clickable widgets that represent the status of work
orders for the current day or Today:

New: Displays the count of today's pending work orders (PPM + Reactive) that
are yet to start.

In Progress: Displays the count of today's work orders (PPM + Reactive) that have
been started.

Closed: Displays the count of today's work orders (PPM + Reactive) that have
been marked as closed.

Overdue: Displays the count of overdue work orders that missed the SLA
resolution time.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 699
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5.3. PPM Work Orders
This section shows the number of assigned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) work orders
and now includes the following clickable widgets:

New: Displays the count of all pending PPM work orders that are yet to start.
In Progress: Displays the count of in-progress PPM work orders that have been

started.
Closed: Displays the count of closed PPM work orders.
Overdue: Displays the count of overdue PPM work orders.

Clicking on any of these widgets will show a list of all the PPM work orders (not just
for today, but all records).

5.4. Reactive Work Orders

This section shows the number of assigned Reactive work orders and includes the
following clickable widgets:

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 700
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New: Displays the count of all pending Reactive work orders.
In Progress: Displays the count of in-progress Reactive work orders.
Closed: Displays the count of closed Reactive work orders.
Overdue: Displays the count of overdue Reactive work orders.

Clicking on any of these widgets will show a list of all Reactive work orders (not just
for today, but all records).

5.5. Snag

This section is designed to manage snags (issues or defects) identified during
maintenance.

Closed: Displays a count of the snags that have been closed.
In Progress: Displays a count of snags that are currently being worked on.
Plus Sign: Clicking on the plus sign opens the Snag Creation form.

The In Progress widget shows the total count of created snags, and clicking the
widget will open a list of these snags.

5.6. Late Work Orders Section

This section shows a count of overdue work orders. Subsections include:

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 701
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Today's Late Orders: Displays the count of late work orders for today.
Last Week: Displays the count of late work orders from the previous week.
Last 2 Weeks: Displays the count of late work orders from the past two weeks.
Over 2 Weeks Ago: Displays the count of late work orders older than two weeks.

Additionally, a graphical representation is included to visualize the data.

5.7. Location Work Orders Pending Section

This section displays the count of pending work orders, categorized by the Business Unit.

5.8. Active PPM by Priority Section

This section shows the priority-wise breakdown of pending Preventive Maintenance
(PPM) work orders.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 702
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The priorities are categorized as:

Urgent
High
Medium
Low

A graphical representation of the data is also displayed.

5.9. Assets

This feature allows users to attach QR scanner codes and geo-location data
(latitude/longitude) to assets for verification purposes. When a technician performs
maintenance, the system can verify whether the task is being executed on the
correct assigned asset.

This ensures accountability, authenticity, and field-level validation during service
execution.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 703
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Scan or upload the QR code that will be used for asset verification.
The QR code should be unique to the asset.
Enter or update the latitude and longitude of the asset. Alternatively, use the

CAFM mobile app to auto-capture the asset's current GPS location.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 704
Farvision Release 4.3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5.10. Snag Creation

The Snag feature in the CAFM Mobile Application allows users, clients, or on-site staff to
report maintenance issues directly from their mobile devices. While reporting a snag, users
can enter a short description and attach images as visual evidence.

All snags submitted through the mobile app are stored as pending and can later be reviewed
and converted into Reactive Work Orders via the web application.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 705

2. Automatic Digital Signature on Final-Approved Documents
High level description:

This enhancement introduces a process for incorporating automatic DigiSign after final approval.
For this, "Enable Digital sign" in the entry type and "DigiSign after final approval" in the Business
rule need to be enabled. This allows digital signature impose automatically after final approval of
the document.

Details:

Navigate for enabling the Digital Sign in the Entry type menu:
Admin module >> Company >> Entry type >> Enable Digital Sign

A checkbox option labeled "DigiSign after final approval" is added on the Business Rule page.
Navigate to:

Admin module >> Workflow >> Business Rule
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

The digital signature added after final approval will be considered valid only if the document
complies with the specific business rules outlined in the business rule section.

Once the document receives final approval, a digital signature will be automatically applied
using the default format(s) specified for the Entry type on the document designer page. The
corresponding default value for the selected format will be printed. At least one format must
be marked as 'Yes' for the digital signature to be printed; otherwise, it will not appear.

Navigate to:
Admin module >> Designer >> Document Designer

Once the final approval is completed, all required information must be available to initiate the
DigiSign process. The scheduler executes the DigiSign process automatically every 1 hour based
on stored configurations and check which documents are approved and pending for digital
signature and does the necessary process.

Navigate to any module for example:
Sales and customer care module >> Collection >> Receipt >> Advance search
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

For the business unit which final approval has been done, the digital sign status show as
UPLOADED, otherwise it will show as BLANK.

Then, click the Print button for document print. Select the category and format(s).

Below, document is showing with the digital signature.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

3. Inclusion of Edit and delete digital sign
High level description:

This enhancement improves the management of Digital Sign by allowing users to select the
document and delete digi-sign associated with it. A hover-able icon on the edit button alerts
users when a document contains a DigiSign, prompting its removal before edits can proceed.

Details:

Visual indicator in the edit button showing if a DigiSign is associated with the document
hoverable icon.

Upon selecting the "i" button a warning message is showing which shows the lists of document
no and format. Users need to mark the formats and click the "delete" button to delete digisign.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

4. Inclusion of "Vacation Rule" in Workflow page

High level description:

The Vacation Rule feature is applicable to enhance to allocate one more user for a particular time
period (vacation period) for a defined entry type for a particular user who is going for vacation.
Documents created during this period against the defined Entry type, Vacation Rule will be
effective and if the On Behalf Of user is involve in the Approval process of that Document, then
along with this User, another user(Allocated to) will be allowed to do the Approval of that
Document.

Details:

Navigate to:
Admin module >> Workflow >> Vacation rule

Field definition:

Entry type: Against the Entry Type for which vacation rule will be implemented.
Is Active: Defines If the Vacation rule is active or not.
Active From: Vacation period starts from this date.
Active to: Vacation period lasts till this date.
On Behalf of: User who is going for vacation.
Allocated to: User whom to allocate for that period.
Description: if any notes to add.

Business rule for a particular entry type for which vacation rule is implemented.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

Vacation rule is showing below for a particular entry-type and date range.

Documents created during the vacation period go for approval to both on behalf of and
Allocated to users. If on behalf of is unavailable, allocated to must be able to approve the
documents. Allocated To can be any Farvision type user (Admin or non-Admin) based on
document approval rights.

Showing the approval history page beyond the mentioned date range.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

5. RFI Enhancement for Approved Documents
High level description:

This feature enhances the Request for Information (RFI) process for approved documents like
Indent, PO, GRN and Purchase Bill within the Material Module.

Details:

A new icon is added and hover-able before the pending approval icon; Tooltip on hover displays
"More Information". This enhancement is only applicable for PR, PO, GRN, Purchase Bill in
material module.

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> company >> Entry type >> "IS RFI E-Mail sent"
checkbox.

If "Is RFI enable" checkbox is enabled, then only "Is RFI Email Send" checkbox can be marked
or unchecked. If "Is RFI enable" checkbox is disabled, "Is RFI Email Send" checkbox will be
blocked.

RFI request with showing below user selects the entry type. Based on the Entry type selection
approved documents populate. User need to fill the detailed RFI request i.e. Subject, Recipient
and description.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

RFI details are showing below.

Users can submit RFI with subject, recipient, and description. Submitted RFIs appear in "RFI
Response" tab under "Open/In Progress" for the respective user's portal.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

In the Admin module, each entry type includes a checkbox labeled "Is RFI E-mail Sent."
When this checkbox is selected, the recipient will receive an email notification. Creator
can only close the thread of the RFI Response after it closes 100% from their end and
that will show as completed.

In RFI detail screen there will be another menu named "History of conversations" along
with Inbox and outbox which shows all the previous conversations history of the RFI
Task.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

A new integration has been done to send WhatsApp through a provider called Mcube.

Farvision UI framework >> Admin >> Communicator >> Config-WhatsApp

Config-WhatsApp details are showing.

Select any document type and click WhatsApp.

WhatsApp Action Status show as completed.

High level description:

A new feature enhancement has been introduced for Profile Tagging functionality in the
Business Rule (Level Setup) section. This feature allows assigning approval levels not only to
specific users but to user profiles, enabling centralized and scalable management of approval
hierarchies.

Details:

Navigate to:
Admin module >> Workflow >> Business Rule

Currently only user option can select, now another option is added that profile can be selected.

If profile(s) is/are selected, then users belongs to these profile(s) will be allowed to do the
approval (maximum 75 users) belongs to these profile will be allowed.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

High level description:

Enhance the SMS configuration to support system-generated configurations that are visible but
non-editable by any users including Admin.

Details:

Navigate to:
Admin module >> Communicator >> Config-SMS

system generated configuration the value for the password is showing as masked/hide.

If there is no default configuration other than system generated configuration, sms will be
trigged through the system generated configuration.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

9. Additional Email ID to the final approval E-mail notification
High level description:

Enhanced the document approval workflow to support notifications to both primary and
secondary email addresses which helps to ensure that final approval messages are also delivered
to alternate email addresses, making sure everyone important stays in the loop.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Administration module >> Security >> User

Final approval notification now supports delivery to Email 2 in addition to Email 1. Email 2 is an
optional field and will receive the same content as Email 1 if configured.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

10. Addition of "Remark" section against attachments
High level description:

The Remarks text field is included with Attachment page; ensuring users can add contextual
notes to their attachments with ease. This enhancement also includes support for accessing the
Attachment page via the toolbar icon, where the Remarks field is displayed correctly.

Details:

The Remarks text field must be visible on the Attachment page. Also, when accessed via the
toolbar icon, the Attachment page must display the Remarks field correctly.

The Remarks text field must be visible on the Attachment page. When accessed via the
toolbar icon, the Attachment page must display the Remarks field correctly.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

11. Enhancement of SMS Register
a) "Excel" button in SMS � Register menu
High level description:

An Excel export icon within the "Sent to Portal" and "Failed" tabs in the Register Email tab has
been added. This enhancement allows users to download the listed SMS records into a
structured Excel file for review.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> Communicator >> Register SMS

An Excel icon is visible on sent to portal tab.

An Excel icon is visible on the failed tab.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

By clicking on Excel the modal must contain a "Selected Days" dropdown allowing users to
choose a date range. When "Today" is selected in the dropdown only SMS entries with a
Compose Date matching the current date must be exported. The exported Excel file must
include all relevant columns and data for that day.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

b) "Failed" tab in SMS-Register menu

High level description:

A Failed tab has been added within the Register-SMS section. This tab is designed to list SMS
transmission failures by providing visibility into Business Unit, to SMS, composed on etc.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> Communicator >> Register-SMS

The tab displays the grid with the columns To SMS, business unit, SMS body, Composed on,
Entry type and Error msg.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

c) Addition of "Business Unit" name in SMS-Register menu

High level description:

In Register-SMS section a new column Business Unit has been added which aims to improve
customer traceability instead of the current system which allows the users to identify by only
their mobile numbers.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> communicator >> Register-SMS

The Business Unit column is visible and properly aligned to all the tabs i.e. Send to Portal,
Outbox and Failed tabs.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

12. Addition of "Amount" in email template based on locale
High level description:

The entire transaction amount will be displayed in email template (E-mail body and/or subject),
formatted using comma separators to the amount to ensure clarity and improve readability
based on user locale. This formatting should apply to all email templates involving financial
details to enhance user experience.

Details:

Transactional amounts in the email include commas as separators. Below image is showing the
amount in Indian format.

Below image is showing the amount in International format.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

13. Implementation of MRT history

The system ensures session isolation and accurate MRT history tracking within the Admin
module, preventing format overrides during opening multiple MRT in concurrent sessions. All
session conflicts are logged and flagged, with detailed audit trails capturing changes, access
events, and interactions for traceability. Currently, MRT history is not available in the front-end,
it is only applicable in the back-end.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

14. Inclusion of "Attachment" option in Business Unit master

High level description:

An "Attachment" tab has been added to the Business Unit section to upload and manage files
related to a specific business unit. Users can select and upload supported file types (e.g., .pdf,
.docx, .jpg, .png) through a file uploader. This enhancement supports centralized documentation,
and operational efficiency.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> Company >> Business unit

Users can add attachments An Attachment tab is included within the Business Unit section.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

Also, users can add attachment from the Business Unit dropdown.

Clicking the view and download icon redirects to show the attachment.

Users must be able to upload files up to 50 MB in specified formats with the data. Uploaded
files must be listed with the columns along with File name, Upload date/time, Uploaded by
(username), File size.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

15. Inclusion of "Last Approval action by" column on the Pending Immediate
Approval Register

High level description:

One new column Last Approval action by has been added in the Pending Immediate Approval
Register. These addition aims to provide enhanced visibility into the recent workflow progress for
each entry, helping users identify status of pending items at a glance.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework>> Admin module >> Report >> Workflow >> Immediate pending
Immediate Approval Register

There is an enhancement that "Last Approval action by" column has been added in pending
Immediate Approval register.
Farvision Release 4.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------.

16. Inclusion of "Created by" column in User List Report
High level description:

The User List Report has been enhanced to include "Created By" column for improved audit
tracking. These fields are access-controlled and available in CSV/PDF exports.

Details:

Navigate to:
Farvision UI Framework >> Admin module >> Report >> User information >> User list

This is a feature enhancement that one new column "Created By" has been included in the User
List Report.

Days: Specifies how many days back the system should check for Employee Confirmation.
Time: Specifies the exact time of day when the alert email should be sent.

confirmation is scheduled for tomorrow (i.e., August 12, 2025) and will send an email alert to their

confirmation is scheduled for three days from now (i.e., August 14, 2025) and will send an email
alert to their reporting manager today (August 11, 2025) at 11:00 AM.

Bill Reversal Functional Rules and Restrictions

Bill Reversal is only permitted if the original bill and the reversal entry fall within the same
accounting month.

If the vendor is subject to a TDS Limit Check, the corresponding purchase bill and non stores
purchase bill will not be eligible for reversal.

Reversed bills must not appear in the Purchase Bill Register & NSP Register.
Reversal bills must not be made available for PDN (Purchase Debit Note) entries.
A bill cannot be reversed if it has been tagged in any of the following transactions:

o Payment Entry
o PDN Entry
o TDS Deposited Entry
o GST Return Filing

Any bill tagged in the above entries is strictly ineligible for reversal.

Once a Bill Reversal entry is posted, it cannot be edited or deleted. If any modification is
required, the user must create a new Bill entry instead.

o The Customer Bill Certify Qty remains zero.

The amount should be entered under ADVANCE RECEIVED billing term.
VAT is also calculated on the ADVANCE RECEIVED billing term amount.

Tag BOQ in Item Info tab.
Ensure Customer Bill Certify Qty and Customer Bill Amount are zero.
Save the bill � system validates billing terms against Basic amount.
In case of advance billing, proceed to Customer Revised RA Bill.
Tag the Customer RA Bill.
Enter advance amount under Advance Received billing term.
System calculates VAT automatically.

31. Addition of Unit Rate Entity/Property in Business Rule for Booking

Description

The system has been enhanced to include the Unit Rate entity/property in the Business Rule
framework for Booking (REALESTATE). This allows users to configure approval workflows based on
the Unit Rate calculated at the time of booking.

Current Logic

Unit Rate was previously derived only for reference as: Area � Rate = Amount
Example: 1250 � 6000 = 7,500,000
After discount (50,000): 7,500,000 - 50,000 = 7,450,000

Required Logic Implemented

Unit Cost = Net Amount after discount (e.g., 7,450,000).
Old Rate = Rate before discount (e.g., 6000).
Area Quantity = e.g., 1250.
New Unit Rate = Unit Cost � Area (e.g., 7,450,000 � 1250 = 5960).

Stored in crm.booking table (Unit Rate column).

1. Automatically send documents for DocuSign after final approval

High level description:
A new DocuSign feature enables documents to be sent for digital signature via email from the
Farvision to the Tenant and pre-defined approver(s). This flow is automatically triggered upon
Final Approval of a document within the Farvision Approval workflow, when enabled through
Business Rule setup. The initial rollout is done with some entry types under Property
Management module, it can be enabled in other modules upon request. `

Details:

The Docusign feature can be set up during the Approval flow creation from the Business
Rule.

On Required Business Rule (for which the DocuSign will be applicable) user has to select the
DigiSign After Final Approval. On selection of DigiSign After Final Approval, user have to
select DigiSign Type as DocuSign

When a Document is created the Tenant is mentioned who will be the first signee of the
Docusign email. The record immediately goes for Approval to the Farvision User(s) as per the
Business Rule setup.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 9

document is in "Pending for Approval" state, while the document is in the Farvision Approval
flow.

Once all the Approvers has approved, the document goes into the Docusign flow with the
tenant being the first signee followed by others. The status is changed to S signifying that the
document is in "Sent for Signing" state.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 10
Farvision Release 4.5

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When any document is approved and signed by each of the required Signees in the Docusign

Document is shown in the attachment Tab and on viewing the document the signatures are
shown.

High level description:
We have developed a new feature such that a configurable retention period can be set in system
settings on request. The system identifies data whose last activity date exceeds the defined

periodically to remove data as per policy. After cleanup, masked data cannot be retrieved,
ensuring compliance with data privacy requirements.

Details:

The Retention Period can be shown in the Enterprise Config page which can be set on
request by Gamut Support team.- The path is as follows:

Report

all data which are inactive for over the mentioned Retention Time.

1. Amount-Based Workflow for Note for Approval (NFA)

This enhancement introduces an amount-based workflow option for the Note for Approval
(NFA) process. By configuring business rules using the Proposed Order Value, organizations can
control approval levels dynamically. When the proposed value exceeds the defined limit, the system
automatically routes the NFA to the appropriate approval authority, ensuring better financial control
and compliance.

Step-by-Step Process

Configure Business Rule

Navigate to: Administration Business Rule.

Select Entry Type: Note for Approval.

Click Add New Row.

Define the condition using Proposed Order Value (amount limit).

Configure approval levels as required.

Save the business rule.

Create Note for Approval Page 131
Go to Material Module Procurement Note for Approval.
Create a new NFA document.
Enter the Proposed Order Value in the document.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited
Farvision Release 4.5

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Submit the NFA.

System Validation

The system evaluates the Proposed Order Value against the configured rule.

If the value exceeds the defined threshold, the approval flow changes automatically as per
the rule.

Example
If a business rule is set where NFA values above 5,00,000 require additional approval:

An NFA created with a Proposed Order Value of 4,50,000 follows the standard approval
flow.

An NFA created with 6,00,000 is routed to higher-level approvers automatically.

Note
The Proposed Order Value is visible in the NFA document for transparency.
Approval routing updates automatically when the value exceeds configured limits.
This feature improves governance, reduces manual intervention, and ensures accurate
approval control based on financial impact.

2. System Stability, Performance and Security Enhancements

Clean-Up Controller: An automated cleanup mechanism has been introduced to remove old
unused data from multiple production databases like Bulk Print Queues, Scheduler Queues,
etc., applying predefined retention rules across framework, scheduler, logging, and system
tables; centrally managed within the system, this ensures consistent database health
without manual intervention.

Database Operations & Reliability Enhancements: We've delivered a comprehensive set of
database maintenance and reliability improvements, to ensure consistent performance, log
backups, daily server health checks, alongside enhanced diagnostics to strengthen
operational stability, performance, and governance across the database environment.

Secure File Upload Validation: We've introduced enhanced file attachment validation to
protect data integrity and system security by enforcing strict checks on both allowed file
extensions and actual content types during upload; files with unsupported formats, or
mismatches between extension and underlying file type are rejected immediately,
preventing invalid files from being attached to documents and ensuring secure, errorfree
processing.

3. Integrated High Performance Caching Layer

High level description:
A new centralized caching layer has been introduced to enhance application performance,
scalability, and resilience. This layer stores frequently accessed data, significantly reducing
repeated read operations on the primary database.
By serving common queries directly from database, the system delivers fast responses even
under high load. The caching mechanism is transparently integrated, requiring no changes to
existing application workflows or business logic.
Purpose:
The purpose of this enhancement is to:
Improve performance: Reduce response times for frequently accessed data by minimizing

database round trips.
Enhance scalability: Offload read pressure from the primary database, enabling the system

to scale more effectively under high concurrency.
Increase resilience: Provide a buffer layer that helps absorb traffic spikes and stabilizes

backend load.
Enable future growth: Establish a foundation for advanced scalability patterns such as

distributed caching, cache invalidation strategies, and horizontal scale-out, without
disrupting current application behavior.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 15

4. Queued Bulk Print should never get stopped

High level description:
With this enhancement, the bulk print processing for both direct pdf printing and pdf sent over
email has been enhanced to ensure that queue execution continues uninterrupted, with no
chances of system failure. The system now handles bulk printing in batches, recovers gracefully
from any issues like system overload or timeout or system update cycles, and guarantees that all
items present in the print queue are processed and printed.
Purpose:
The purpose of this enhancement is to:
Ensure completion: Guarantee that all queued print items are printed without manual

intervention.
Improve reliability: Eliminate failures caused by temporary system issues, overload, or

execution timeouts.
Enhance user confidence: Provide a consistent and predictable bulk print experience.
Reduce operational overhead: Minimize support and reprocessing efforts caused by partial

or failed bulk print jobs.

� Gamut Infosystems Limited Page 16

5. Timeout Error Handling with User-Friendly Notifications

High level description:
This enhancement improves system behavior when backend queries exceed their execution time
limits. Previously, when a query timed out, the UI loader continued spinning without providing
feedback to the user. With this update, the system now detects timeout exceptions and
communicates them to the frontend, displaying a pop-up notification informing the user that a
timeout has occurred.
Purpose:
The purpose of this enhancement is to:
Improve user experience by clearly notifying users when a request times out instead of

leaving the UI in a loading state
Ensure consistent timeout handling across all modules
Enhance system transparency while avoiding confusion caused by unresponsive screens
Prevent security risks by masking backend implementation details such as database type
Enable better error diagnostics and categorization internally through standardized timeout

codes.
By handling query timeouts gracefully and securely, this feature increases system reliability, user
confidence, and operational robustness across Farvision.
Steps:
When the refresh button or the excel button is clicked in reports or when a page is

reloaded, for both the cases if any request time out error occurs a toast message will

approver only warning mechanism. A new configuration flag, "Mandatory in transaction,"

Inactive rules are automatically excluded from validation, and the Active status is configurable,
visible, and searchable in the rule listing.

document creation via import while continuing to apply during normal manual entry.

administrative flexibility and operational efficiency. Key benefits include:
Enforced submission of supporting documents for all transactions
Improved data accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
Stronger internal controls aligned with governance policies
Ability to temporarily disable or adjust rules without reconfiguration
Reduced risk of import failures during bulk or automated data processing
Clear visibility into rule enforcement and status

follows:

amount.
(-) Round-Off value -- The round-off amount is subtracted from the final
payment amount.
o In case of Receipt:
The behaviour is vice-versa compared to Payment
(+) Round-Off value -- The round-off amount is subtracted from the final
receipt amount.
(-) Round-Off value -- The round-off amount is added to the final receipt
amount.

forms.

2. Accurate Auto Indent Quantity after Inter Location Stock Transfer

High Level Description:

The Auto Indent quantity calculation has been improved to consider materials transferred from one
Business Unit to another through Inter Location Stock Transfer.

When material is transferred out from a Business Unit, that material is no longer available for its
Work Order activity. Therefore, the transferred quantity will be added back to the pending quantity
shown in Auto Indent.

When the receiving Business Unit receives the material through an ILTO Goods Receipt Note, the
received quantity will be deducted from its pending material requirement. This will prevent the
receiving Business Unit from raising another indent for material that has already been received.

The calculation will be performed separately for each Work Order, Activity and Material. If Substitute
Items are used in place of the Original Item, the system will consider the quantities of both the
Original and Substitute Items while calculating the pending requirement.

Purpose:

between Business Units.

This enhancement will help users to:

Raise a new indent for material transferred out from the sender Business Unit.
Avoid duplicate indenting for material already received by the receiver Business Unit.
Improve Work Order and Activitywise material planning.
Reduce the risk of excess purchasing or material shortages.
Consider both Original and Substitute Item quantities correctly.

4. Material Reconciliation Based on Physical Stock and Book Stock Difference

High Level Description:

A new Material Reconciliation provision has been introduced in the Engineering Module to reconcile
warehouse-level physical material stock with the corresponding book stock for a selected Contractor
and Work Order. The system compares the Physical Stock with the Book Stock and calculates the
excess or shortage quantity.

The calculated difference is distributed across the applicable Work Order activities in proportion to
their respective Work Done Quantities.

Calculation Logic:

When Physical Stock is greater than Book Stock: Excess Quantity = Physical Stock - Book
Stock

When Physical Stock is less than Book Stock: Shortage Quantity = Book Stock - Physical Stock
Activity-wise reconciliation quantity is calculated as: Stock Difference � Activity Work Done

Quantity � Total Work Done Quantity

Example:

Physical Stock: 100 Bags

Book Stock: 97.23 Bags

Excess Quantity: 2.77 Bags

Total Work Done Quantity: 102.77

For an activity having Work Done Quantity of 38.79:

2.77 � 38.79 � 102.77 = 1.046 Bags

The same proportionate calculation is applied to all applicable activities, and the total distributed
quantity remains equal to the identified stock difference.

Purpose:

To reconcile actual warehouse stock with system-maintained book stock.
To identify material excess or shortage against a Contractor and Work Order.
To distribute the stock difference systematically across Work Order activities.
To maintain accurate material consumption and stock records.
To reduce manual reconciliation calculations and related errors.

45.Introduce HR MeterBased Working Hour Calculation in Logbook Entry

High level Description:

In the Engineering Module, the Work Done � Logbook Entry process has been enhanced with two
new fields: Start HR Reading and End HR Reading. These fields allow equipment working hours to be
calculated based on HR meter readings instead of depending only on In Time and Out Time.

For the first Logbook activity entry of a shift or day, the user must enter both Start HR Reading and
End HR Reading manually. For each subsequent activity entry, the system will automatically carry
forward the previous activity's End HR Reading as the next Start HR Reading and keep it noneditable.
The user will enter only the new End HR Reading.

The system will calculate the equipment working hours as:

Hours Worked = End HR Reading � Start HR Reading

In Time and Out Time, or
Start HR Reading and End HR Reading

Both calculation methods cannot be used together in the same activity entry. The Logbook import
process and existing equipmentrelated reports have also been updated to support HR meterbased
details.

Purpose:

This enhancement is required to provide a more accurate method of recording equipment operating
hours. In many site operations, actual equipment usage is tracked through the machine's HR meter
rather than only through clock time. Timebased entries may not always represent the actual running
duration when equipment remains idle during part of a shift.

With this enhancement:

Actual equipment usage can be recorded through HR meter readings.
Start HR is automatically carried forward from the previous End HR reading.
Manual errors and gaps between consecutive activity readings are reduced.
Users can continue using the existing timebased calculation where required.
The system prevents the simultaneous use of timebased and HR meterbased values.
HR meter information can be uploaded through the Logbook import process.
Equipmentrelated reports will display the applicable Start HR and End HR details.
